# One prompt, 8 hours: Claude Code generated an entire app launch video

**[Open original ↗](https://x.com/LexnLin/status/2104148233106723099)** · `Leon Lin` · 2026-09-27 · 86 replies · 47 reposts · 1,279 likes · 90.1K views · 1,315 bookmarks · 🎬

## 💬 Essence

Leon Lin gave Claude Code (Opus 5.5) one prompt to make a launch video for a fake calendar app and claims everything you see and hear - name, logo, UI, animations, soundtrack, sound effects - is code, after it 'cooked for about 8h'. The self-thread drops the repo (github.com/Leonxlnx/claude-launchvideo) with code, soundtrack and video in it, clarifies the 8h includes reviews and recording (the cloud agent took 30 min), and the author concedes the criticism himself: 'the soundeffects and bg soundtrack don't really match this type of video'. Replies agree on visuals but not audio: mehdi calls it 'by far the best launch video generated by opus 5.5 by a mile', Witti says it is 'master-class' yet dislikes the AI-made music in these videos, and Arthur jokes 'at this point i don't even know if people are joking or not'. 86 replies, 1,279 likes, 1,315 bookmarks, 90.1K views.

## 💡 Takeaway

End-to-end launch-video production from one prompt is now a working demo - worth planning agent-generated video into your own launch pipeline.
